initial_errors.cause: SPF fail alone crossed the auth structured-suspicion threshold even though DKIM and DMARC both passed.

generalized_changes: Treat isolated SPF failure as non-positive only when both DKIM and DMARC pass, the score is at most 24, and no independent structured suspicion is present.
Use the packaged Public Suffix List snapshot without a writable or network-backed tldextract cache.
Correct evaluation arithmetic to exclude data completeness from score categories and use observable environment metadata for export-safety invariants.
